description: This file defines types, constants, and functions related to Matrix poll events, including poll creation, responses, and result processing.

methods.name: isPollStartType
methods.description: Checks if the event type is a poll start type.

methods.name: isPollResponseType
methods.description: Checks if the event type is a poll response type.

methods.name: isPollEndType
methods.description: Checks if the event type is a poll end type.

methods.name: isPollEventType
methods.description: Checks if the event type is any poll event type.

methods.name: getTextContent
methods.description: Extracts the text content from a TextContent object.

methods.name: parsePollStart
methods.description: Parses a poll start content into a structured format.

methods.name: parsePollStartContent
methods.description: Converts poll start content into a poll summary.

methods.name: formatPollAsText
methods.description: Formats a poll summary into a human-readable string.

methods.name: resolvePollReferenceEventId
methods.description: Extracts the referenced event ID from poll content.

methods.name: parsePollResponseAnswerIds
methods.description: Extracts answer IDs from poll response content.

methods.name: buildPollResultsSummary
methods.description: Builds a detailed poll results summary including votes.

methods.name: formatPollResultsAsText
methods.description: Formats poll results into a human-readable string.

methods.name: buildPollStartContent
methods.description: Constructs poll start content from input data.

methods.name: buildPollResponseContent
methods.description: Constructs poll response content referencing a poll event.
